objective: Implement strict story readers and read-only upstream-compatible project inspector

acceptance.text: Valid current upstream projects produce matching derived phase, approval, claims, sprint, worktree and handoff state against unchanged pinned inspector.
Strict story parsing preserves exact ordered criterion text and substantive contract hash while precisely separating Execution metadata; unsafe or duplicate sections fail.
Inspection handles malformed/missing/FIFO/symlink inputs and missing identity without mutation, hangs or false completion, and pm status exposes it without breaking legacy reads.
